title: Thousands march in Madrid to protest eviction of 87-year-old woman
summary: The eviction of 87-year-old Maricarmen Abascal on Wednesday sparked a thousands-strong protest in the streets of Madrid Saturday, with demonstrators calling for greater protection for tenants.
